query.title: Search query
query.description: Web search query. The top `maxResults` results are opened and returned as markdown. Leave empty if you only pass `urls`.

urls.title: URLs to read
urls.description: Pages or PDF links to read directly (max 50). Can be combined with `query`.

maxResults.title: Search results to read
maxResults.description: How many search results to open (1-10). Default 3.

maxCharsPerResult.title: Max characters per result
maxCharsPerResult.description: Token budget: each result's markdown is cut at a paragraph boundary to this many characters (about 4 characters = 1 token). Default 6000 (~1,500 tokens). `totalChars` and `truncated` tell you what was cut.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: `markdown` returns the main content; `summary` returns a short lead + outline to triage many pages cheaply in tokens. Same price.

includeLinks.title: Keep hyperlinks
includeLinks.description: Keep `[text](url)` links in the markdown. Off by default to save tokens.

fullPage.title: Full page (skip main-content extraction)
fullPage.description: Return the whole page body instead of the extracted main article. Use for list/index pages.

country.title: Search country
country.description: Optional 2-letter country code for localized search results, e.g. `us`, `gb`, `de`.

maxPdfPages.title: Max PDF pages
maxPdfPages.description: Read at most this many pages of each PDF. Default 50.

timeoutSecs.title: Per-URL timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a URL after this many seconds and return an error row for it (not charged). Default 15.
